name: Opening-roster athlete card - Lena Fischer

values.Name: Lena Fischer
values.Quote: I spent a decade telling myself I wasn't an athlete, that lifting was for other people, the kind who looked the part, and then two coaches in a borrowed room put a barbell in my hands and refused to let me apologise for taking up space, and somewhere between my first empty-bar squat and the day I pulled a hundred and ten kilos off the floor I stopped believing the story I'd been told and started believing the numbers, and the numbers do not lie and do not flatter, they just tell you the truth about the work you did.

name: Opening-roster athlete card - Grace Amadi

values.Name: Grace Amadi
values.Quote: People ask why I compete when I'll never win a national meet, and the honest answer is that the platform is the only place I've found where the goal is completely, ruthlessly clear: three lifts, three attempts each, a number that either goes up or it doesn't, no politics and no talking your way out of it, and every grey morning I've dragged myself in here half-asleep and doubting the point of it has ended with me chalked up and certain, because the barbell gave me back a kind of honesty I didn't know I was missing.
